title: Bright Light
subtitle: Normal vision
description: Bright light lets most creatures see normally. Even on a gloomy day, most outdoor environments are in bright light.

bullets.content: Torches, lanterns, fires, and various spells are common sources of bright light.

title: Darkness
subtitle: Creates heavy obscurement
description: Darkness creates a heavily obscured area. It is found in unlit dungeons, outdoors at night, or within areas of magical darkness.

bullets.content: A creature in a heavily obscured area is effectively Blinded.

title: Dim Light
subtitle: Creates light obscurement
description: Dim light, also called shadows, creates a lightly obscured area. It often forms a boundary between bright light and darkness.

bullets.content: Creatures in a lightly obscured area have disadvantage on certain Wisdom and Intelligence checks that rely on sight.

title: Half Cover
subtitle: +2 bonus to AC & DEX saves
description: A target has Half Cover if an obstacle blocks at least half of its body.

bullets.content: A target with half cover has a +2 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws. If a target is behind multiple sources of cover, only the most protective degree of cover applies.

title: Heavily Obscured
subtitle: Effectively Blinded
description: An area is Heavily Obscured if it contains darkness, opaque fog, or dense foliage. Vision is blocked.

bullets.content: A creature trying to see something in a Heavily Obscured area has the Blinded condition.

title: Lightly Obscured
subtitle: Disadvantage on some checks
description: An area is Lightly Obscured if it contains dim light, patchy fog, or moderate foliage. Vision is hindered.

bullets.content: Creatures have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception), Intelligence (Investigation), and Wisdom (Survival) checks that rely on sight.

title: Three-Quarters Cover
subtitle: +5 bonus to AC & DEX saves
description: A target has Three-Quarters Cover if about three-quarters of it is covered by an obstacle.

bullets.content: A target with three-quarters cover has a +5 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws. If a target is behind multiple sources of cover, only the most protective degree of cover applies.

title: Total Cover
subtitle: Cannot be targeted directly
description: A target has Total Cover if it is completely concealed by an obstacle.

bullets.content: A target with Total Cover can’t be targeted directly by an attack or a spell, though it can be affected by spells with an area of effect.

title: Blindsight
subtitle: Perceive without sight
description: You can see within a specified range without relying on physical sight.

bullets.content: A creature with blindsight has the following benefits:

items: You can see anything not behind Total Cover, even if you are Blinded or in Darkness.
You can see something that has the Invisible condition.

bullets.content: This sense is common for creatures without eyes or those with echolocation.

title: Darkvision
subtitle: Superior vision in low light
description: You can see in dim light and darkness within a specified range.

bullets.content: A creature with darkvision has the following benefits:

items: You can see in Dim Light as if it were Bright Light.
You can see in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.

bullets.content: You can’t discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

title: Tremorsense
subtitle: Sense vibrations in the ground
description: You can pinpoint the location of creatures and moving objects in contact with the same surface or liquid as you.

bullets.content: Tremorsense does not count as a form of sight and cannot detect airborne creatures.

title: Truesight
subtitle: See things as they truly are
description: Your vision is enhanced within a specified range, allowing you to pierce illusions and see into other planes.

bullets.content: A creature with truesight gains all the following benefits:

items: You can see in normal and magical Darkness.
You can see Invisible creatures and objects.
Visual illusions appear transparent to you.
You discern the true form of shapechangers or transformed creatures.
You can see into the Ethereal Plane.

bullets.content: This is a rare and powerful form of sight.
